segments.ja315:1.1: Pharusā vata te vācā, maṃsaṃ [samma (pī. ka.)] yācanako asi [casi (pī.)];
segments.ja315:1.3: Kilomasadisī [kilomassa sadisā (pī.)] vācā, kilomaṃ samma dammi te.
segments.ja315:2.3: Aṅgassa sadisī vācā [aṅgassadisī te vācā (ka.)], aṅgaṃ samma dadāmi te.
segments.ja315:3.1: Tātāti putto vadamāno, kampeti [sammeti (ka.)] hadayaṃ pitu;
segments.ja315:3.3: Hadayassa sadisī [hadayassadisī (ka.)] vācā, hadayaṃ samma dammi te.
segments.ja315:4.1: Yassa gāme sakhā natthi, yathāraññaṃ tatheva taṃ;
segments.ja315:4.3: Sabbassa sadisī vācā, sabbaṃ samma dadāmi teti.
